# Competitive Signal Report — Enterprise AI Platform (Thursday, 27 August 2026)

> **Bottom line:** Salesforce's aggressive Agentforce ARR growth and new pricing models highlight their platform-centric approach, creating opportunities for Kore.ai to emphasize our purpose-built CX AI platform's predictable TCO and proven analyst leadership in the conversational AI for CX space. Glean's move into enterprise AI agents, while employee-facing, reinforces the market's shift towards AI-driven productivity, but also underscores their lack of CX-specific validation, a key differentiator for Kore.ai.

## Three signals that matter
### Salesforce Agentforce ARR Surges, Pricing Evolves
**What happened —** (2026-08-27) Salesforce reported Agentforce ARR exceeding $1.2 billion, a 205% YoY increase, and announced a new pricing model featuring "Flex Credits" ($0.10/credit) for agentic actions, alongside per-user SKUs. [Salesforce](https://news.google.?oc=5)
**What it means for Kore.ai —** This rapid ARR growth validates the agentic AI market, but their evolving, credit-based pricing introduces TCO unpredictability. Kore.ai can counter by highlighting our deterministic ABL pricing and proven cost attribution, emphasizing predictable ROI for enterprise CX.

### Glean Launches Enterprise AI Agents, Broadening Scope
**What happened —** (2026-08-27) Glean launched "Tau," a desktop workspace for enterprise AI agents, aiming to cut token costs and address AI sprawl. [SecurityBrief Asia](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxPc0RGUW5qYUZyYjEwWW13M05NLWJTaXZEQTJqMWJNWFpDdFMtUEFtVFRVempiNTFHSVl0OUpLYTFMd254Sm84dHl0STVTb0l0b2xrQllWV2xlTWVOQWJlSjhMS1BCUXEyeERZQ0VBWWVKUG1jaFJyak9xSnl6aHhPMndSMkFsb1Z5Q2JwNw?oc=5)
**What it means for Kore.ai —** Glean's expansion into enterprise AI agents, while employee-facing, signals market demand for AI-driven productivity. This reinforces Kore.ai's position as a leader in *customer-facing* agentic AI, with strong CX analyst validation that Glean lacks.

### NICE Cognigy Integrates Route 101 for Contact Center Modernization
**What happened —** (2026-08-26) HM Land Registry selected Route 101 to modernize its contact center, leveraging AI-enabled capabilities. [THINK Digital Partners](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiugFBVV95cUxPR24tNE1tdnVvY1I0QUFad3pCRlBuOGY0Q2RPRjlIT1RSVUlHNlQ2VUtsX3pOdjlnVDRwVk51QnhFOU14Rm1FMnlXdXVGMzZPT1drMU9OUlFjdEwwb1JUWlk0YWFwdnZIZ3NFTVFJNVZud1RtLTVTSEtnSS1WSG1oUHhRNFlmVmg1NnVhUEYxd1Rhb3c1XzFJWUp3R3NoaUdmSU9EZlMzTjBYTEVJU2xaS25aNmpfa0xvVVE?oc=5)
**What it means for Kore.ai —** This win for Route 101, a NICE Cognigy partner, highlights the ongoing adoption of AI in contact centers. Kore.ai can leverage its own leadership in independent CX analyst evaluations (Forrester, Gartner) to underscore our platform's broader, proven capabilities beyond specific partner integrations.

## Watch for
- Salesforce's continued evolution of Agentforce pricing and its impact on enterprise adoption.
- Further details on Glean's "Tau" capabilities and any potential expansion into customer-facing use cases.

## Recommended actions
- Arm Sales with messaging on Kore.ai's predictable TCO and cost-per-outcome advantage against Salesforce's credit-based models.
- Emphasize Kore.ai's leadership in independent CX analyst evaluations (Gartner, Forrester) when competing against vendors with employee-focused AI or limited CX validation.
- Highlight Kore.ai's true omnichannel capabilities (voice and digital) as a differentiator against voice-first or digitally-focused competitors.
- Reinforce the "platform" advantage of Kore.ai's single stack for CX automation versus fragmented or bolt-on solutions.
